title: Ronan Saves the Kree (Everyone's Shocked)
description: With the force fields dying and the Kree flank overrun, a wanted fugitive turns a slaughter into a retreat - right before something worse shows up.
hook_note: Picks up on the exact collapse we left on, naming who's caught in it so the panic lands instantly.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: So the force fields are dying and everyone's screaming about the right flank.

segments.text: So the force fields are dying and everyone's screaming about the right flank.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Somebody asks who's even on the right flank. Quill snaps back, 'Does it matter?'

segments.text: Somebody asks who's even on the right flank.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Spoiler: it does. The right flank is two Kree battalions, and they've just been breached.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And here's the thing - the Kree live for war, but their command has completely fallen apart.

shots.line: Ever since House Fiyero took Hala, they just throw warm bodies at the Wave.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: That guy is Ronan - used to be the Accuser, judge, jury and executioner of the Kree.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Small problem: now he's a fugitive from the exact justice he used to hand out.

shots.line: A Kree officer sneers that Ronan carries no authority, their loyalty's to House Fiyero.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Ronan's answer is short and cold: 'You're relieved of duty.'

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And the rank-and-file Kree? They don't buy the charges. He talks, they listen.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: So he takes a guaranteed bloodbath and turns it into a clean, orderly withdrawal.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Hardest-hit positions, fewest deaths. Rich's verdict? 'Ronan's a keeper.'

shots.line: Right on cue, Quill screams the generators are giving out - move.

shots.line: Rich calls the third full retreat in this fight, pulling everyone to the secondary perimeter.

shots.line: But here's his edge: the Wave's still fighting the same war they fought six months ago. He isn't.

shots.line: Holding that airspace are three ex-Heralds of Galactus, who does not care about you.
